name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator shows bullish signals (column value >2 and color <3) and sell positions when it shows bearish signals (column value <2 and color >1). It includes configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options with separate controls for opening and closing positions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System自定义指标的交易信号进行操作，当指标显示看涨信号时开多仓，显示看跌信号时开空仓。它包含可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项，并分别控制开仓和平仓操作。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于成交量加权移动平均线的数字化系统，通过自定义指标Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System生成买卖信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区6的第1根K线值大于2且颜色值小于3时，开启买入信号；当该值小于2且颜色值大于1时，开启卖出信号。出场条件通过独立的布尔开关控制，买入平仓在卖出信号触发时执行，卖出平仓在买入信号触发时执行。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金、余额、亏损后自由保证金、亏损后余额和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1手，止损1000点、止盈2000点。策略在每根新K线形成时计算信号，避免重复交易，同时通过IsNewBar机制确保信号只在新的价格柱上生成。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a volume-weighted moving average digitized system that generates buy and sell signals through the custom Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System indicator. Entry conditions are: when indicator buffer 6's value at bar 1 exceeds 2 and its color value is below 3, a buy signal is triggered; when the value drops below 2 and the color exceeds 1, a sell signal is triggered. Exit conditions are controlled by separate boolean switches where buy positions close when sell signals appear and sell positions close when buy signals appear. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 lots, a stop loss of 1000 points, and a take profit of 2000 points. The strategy recalculates signals only on new bar formation to avoid repetitive trades, using the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are generated only on new price bars.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio, controls trade lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：自由保证金/余额/亏损后自由保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode: Fixed lot or margin-based ratio

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: 成交量加权MA的周期长度

parameters.name: VolumeType
parameters.description: 成交量类型：tick成交量或真实成交量
parameters.description_en: Volume type (Tick volume or Real volume)

parameters.name: Digit
parameters.description_en: Number of digits for indicator digitization

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: 指标相对于价格序列的偏移量

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引

pros: 独立的买卖开平仓控制开关，灵活性高，可单独禁用某方向交易
使用新K线检测机制(IsNewBar)避免信号重复计算和频繁交易
支持多种仓位计算模式，适应不同风险偏好的交易者
成交量加权移动平均线比普通MA更反映市场真实供需关系
止损止盈参数可配置，风险控制框架基本完整
pros_en: Independent buy/sell open/close control switches provide high flexibility, allowing selective disabling of any direction
New bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) prevents signal recalculation and excessive trading frequency
Multiple position sizing modes accommodate different risk preferences of traders
Volume-weighted moving average reflects real market supply and demand better than simple MA
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值过大，可能导致单笔亏损严重
缺少点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
依赖外部自定义指标文件，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
没有持仓检查机制，可能重复开仓导致仓位叠加
信号逻辑简单，仅依赖单指标双缓冲区数值比较，缺乏多维度确认
cons_en: Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large, potentially causing severe single-trade losses
No spread filter mechanism may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Dependency on external custom indicator file means the EA fails if the indicator is missing
No position check mechanism may lead to duplicate position openings and accumulated exposure
Simple signal logic relying solely on single-indicator dual-buffer value comparison lacks multi-dimensional confirmation
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过度叠加
添加点差过滤和时间过滤机制，避免在流动性差或高点差时段交易
增加移动止损或追踪止损功能，在盈利时保护利润
将止损止盈默认值缩小至合理范围，或加入ATR动态止损机制
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent duplicate same-direction openings causing excessive position accumulation
Add spread and time filters to avoid trading during low-liquidity or high-spread periods
Implement trailing stop functionality to protect profits when positions move favorably
Reduce default stop loss/take profit to reasonable ranges or implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss

risk_points: 缺少持仓数量检查，可能在同方向重复开仓
默认止损1000点过大，单笔可能亏损严重
无点差过滤，高点差环境下交易成本不可控
依赖外部指标文件，若缺失则初始化失败但不会崩溃
risk_points_en: No position count check may lead to repeated same-direction position openings
Default 1000-point stop loss is excessively large, potentially causing severe single-trade losses
No spread filter means trading costs are uncontrolled in high-spread environments
Dependency on external indicator file causes initialization failure if missing, though it handles this gracefully

It includes configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options with separate controls for opening and closing positions.
